name: Finanze
description: Self-hosted, private personal finance and net worth tracker that aggregates assets and investments across banks, brokers, crowdfunding platforms, crypto exchanges/wallets and real estate into one place.

notes.text: The web UI is served on port 8080 (Nginx) and talks to the backend API on port 7592. Both must be reachable from your browser/network.
On first visit you'll be asked to create a local account; all data is stored encrypted in /opt/finanze/.storage inside the container.

Trade Republic login needs the Finanze desktop app (it solves TR's anti-bot challenge in a real browser window, which the web UI can't do). Install the desktop app on your computer (same version as the container), go to Settings > Advanced Settings > Server URL, set it to http://<IP>:7592 and log in to Trade Republic from there. The session is stored in the container, so the web UI can sync it until TR asks for a new login.
Mintos is not supported: it needs Selenium/reCAPTCHA dependencies that this script does not install.
